title: Plan a follow-up call some working days ahead
rule: Time comes from the injected clock, never from `new Date()` in a rule; a business date uses the Europe/Berlin calendar; tests use a fixed clock (kernel AGENTS.md, docs/conventions/data.md and testing.md)
source: anifit-platform #238: a test asked at a fixed time while the code used the real clock; some hours after the merge it failed on dev (fixed in #249). AN-147: the reviewer found a handler that passed no `now`, with a test on a fixed date ("the test breaks in 5 days").
prompt:
Advisors plan a follow-up call a few working days ahead.

- Add `createFollowUp(personId, workingDays)` to the public API of the journey module. It creates a task of kind `follow-up` with the title `Follow-up call` and returns it.
- The due date is `workingDays` working days after today. Today is the business date. Working days are Monday to Friday; public holidays are treated like any other day.
- `workingDays` is a whole number from 1 to 30. Anything else fails.
- `createApp()` in `apps/worker` must expose it as `app.journey.createFollowUp`.

When you are done, the change must be ready for a pull request.
